definitions.explanation: a mesh utensil used for scooping or straining food from liquids
a net used for scooping fish or other items from water

examples.japanese: すくい{網|あみ}で{麺|めん}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To scoop out the noodles with a strainer.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{物|もの}をすくい{網|あみ}で{油|あぶら}から{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: To lift fried food out of the oil with a skimmer.

examples.japanese: すくい{網|あみ}で{天|てん}かすを{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く。
examples.english: To remove tempura bits with a skimmer.

examples.japanese: すくい{網|あみ}で{金魚|きんぎょ}をすくう。
examples.english: To scoop goldfish with a net.

examples.japanese: {細|こま}かいすくい{網|あみ}が{便利|べんり}だ。
{落|お}ち{葉|ば}をすくい{網|あみ}で{集|あつ}める。
examples.english: To collect fallen leaves with a scooping net.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちがすくい{網|あみ}で{川|かわ}の{小魚|こざかな}を{捕|つか}まえている。
examples.english: The children are catching small fish in the river with scooping nets.

notes:
すくい{網|あみ} is a mesh utensil for scooping items from liquid.

WORD FORMATION:
すくう (to scoop) + {網|あみ} (net/mesh)

KITCHEN USE:
- {麺|めん}をすくう: to scoop noodles
- {揚|あ}げ{物|もの}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す: to lift out fried food
- {灰汁|あく}を{取|と}る: to skim off scum
- {天|てん}かすを{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く: to remove tempura bits

OTHER USES:
- {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい: goldfish scooping (festival game)
- {落|お}ち{葉|ば}を{集|あつ}める: to collect fallen leaves

ALTERNATIVE NAMES:
- {網杓子|あみじゃくし}: mesh ladle
- スキマー: skimmer (loanword)

RELATED TOOLS:
- {灰汁取|あくと}り: scum skimmer (fine mesh)
- {穴杓子|あなじゃくし}: slotted spoon
- ザル: colander (for draining)
